newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek rate easing depends on budget - cen bank.
newsitem.headline: Greek rate easing depends on budget - cen bank.

text.p: Greek central bank governor Lucas Papademos told an Economist conference on Wednesday that future interest rate easing will depend on progress in budget deficit reduction.
"The prospect for a further drop in interest rates depends definitely on the reduction of the budget deficit," Papademos said.
"The course of inflation in the recent past is just an element that sets interest rate policy," he added.
CPI-inflation fell to 6.0 percent year-on-year in March from 6.6 percent in February. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Intercontinental Newsroom +301 3311812-4
